limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: SHT30 exact part; finite digital model, no physical humidity/thermal accuracy.
Core temperature within -40..125C; other encoding probes diagnostics only.
Per-word CRC required by selected task integrity function, not universally mandatory for SHT30.
CRC fault cases test bounded no-invalid-success, not mandatory immediate error or complete recovery.
Allow retained validated values and caches; no automatic history invalidation on later bus errors.
NACK before ready, reset and 1ms inter-command timing modeled; not bit-level electrical validation.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile candidate code.
